fullPassage: Different disciplines use various methods of proof to justify their evaluations, but not all methods can be adapted to suit every field. In art criticism, for instance, deduction often fails. Deductive reasoning involves presenting statements to support an opinion, and if everyone agrees with these statements, they should also agree with the conclusion. However, agreement on certain aspects of an artwork does not necessarily bring about a consensus on its overall quality due to art’s subjective nature, rendering deduction not very effective. Induction, which entails drawing inferences based on observations, is slightly more applicable but is not without flaws. For instance, it has been observed that many admired artworks feature the golden ratio, leading to the inference that incorporating the golden ratio elevates an artwork’s aesthetic value. This generalization fails to consider the fact that there are both admired artworks that lack this ratio and unsuccessful works that include it. More likely than not, someone detected the golden ratio in an artwork after noting certain qualities, such as color and composition, that they personally felt made the artwork aesthetically pleasing. Once again, it all boils down to individual perception shaping one’s judgment of art.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 빈칸 앞에 be동사(is)와 비교급 more가 있어 형용사 자리이므로, 동사 apply를 형용사형 applicable(적용 가능한)로 바꿔야 함
det.analysis:
is slightly more 다음에는 형용사가 와야 하므로 동사 apply를 형용사 applicable로 바꾸는 것이 정답

det.tip: 동사 apply → 형용사 applicable. be동사 + more ___ 는 형용사 자리
